system.description:
You angle the weighted end of your Flail behind you before shifting your weight forward while maneuvering the flail around your side, sending a devastating arc of force towards an opponent, looking to remove them from the battle field in one fell swoop. Make a melee Taijutsu attack dealing your [Weapons damage] + 6d6 and they must make a Strength saving throw to resist being thrown a number of feet backwards equal to 10 x your Taijutsu ability modifier on a failed save.

If the target collides with another creature, that creature must make a Dexterity Saving thrown, on a failure both creatures take 4d6 bludgeoning damage.

On a success, the primary target still suffers 4d6 bludgeoning damage, but the second target only takes half.

Chain 2: If the target creature currently has penalties to their speed, they make their Saving throw at disadvantage.

Chain 3: Affected creatures that strike a wall are Staggered.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast above A-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and both instances of damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, if the target creature fails their saving throw by 5 or more, you may recast this jutsu at A-Rank, at 0 cost, but must target a different creature.
